profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: As a Software Engineer I've had the privilege of contributing to a wide array of projects using Ruby, PHP, Node.js, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I'm driven by a desire to build elegant and efficient software that makes a real difference. Always looking for new challenges and opportunities to apply my expertise and grow alongside forward-thinking teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build and ship full stack product features in collaboration with product and design, from technical planning to production rollout.
• Improve application reliability and maintainability through targeted refactors, stronger test coverage, and tighter code review practices.
• Design and implement backend and frontend improvements that reduce friction in core user workflows.
• Partner across teams to break down requirements into scoped, incremental releases that improve delivery speed and quality.
• Monitor post-release behavior and iterate quickly to resolve issues and optimize performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · PHP · Software Design · React.js · Software Development · Go (Programming Language) · Software Systems Engineering · Microservices · JavaScript · Developer Tools

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered full stack features in close partnership with product and design, ensuring consistent UX and dependable functionality as the platform evolved.
• Improved platform performance, scalability, and reliability through ongoing backend and frontend optimization work.
• Implemented and monitored production changes, using feedback and metrics to drive iterative improvements.
• Contributed to technical decisions that balanced speed of delivery with long-term maintainability.
• Helped strengthen engineering execution through code reviews, collaboration, and cross-functional communication.
positions.insights: Skills: Developer Tools · Ruby · Problem Solving · Version Control · Oral Communication · PostgreSQL · Documentation · Troubleshooting · Redis · Build Strong Relationships · Software Design · Technical Architecture · Back-End Web Development · Communication · Programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Model-View-Controller (MVC)

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained, refactored, and extended a large production codebase while delivering new features and internal tooling.
• Led feature development from requirements and technical design through deployment and post-launch iteration.
• Improved web performance and user experience across O&O properties using Core Web Vitals insights.
• Collaborated with engineers and stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
• Participated in code reviews, technical planning, and pair programming to improve delivery quality.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
• Create and maintain internal tools and solutions that impact the overall digital team workflow 
• Built and maintained internal tools that improved digital team workflows and day to day operational efficiency.
• Developed microsites and rich ad experiences that increased brand engagement and campaign impact.
• Maintained the network JavaScript tag serving millions of ad requests per day.
• Delivered optimizations that increased ad inventory by 30% and improved ad viewability by 20% (IAS/Moat standards).
• Mentored junior engineers and supported technical onboarding and execution.
• Interviewed candidates and reviewed technical submissions to support hiring decisions.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with the Director of eCommerce and Project Managers to design, develop and prototype landing pages and new site functionalities.

Main Tasks / Accomplishments:
• Redesigned the e-commerce home page which boosted user engagement and increased sales
• Developed new site functionalities utilizing HTML, CSS and JavaScript
• Crafted effective banners and marketing email designs to launch paid digital media campaigns across multiple markets
• Improved the appearance and developed new functionalities for the company’s AngularJS based mobile app
• Maintained several co-brands sites based on WordPress to create other revenue streams
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Version Control · Troubleshooting · Programming

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Maintained and enhanced internal web applications to support business operations.
• Built promotional microsites and ad units that increased social and campaign engagement.
• Partnered with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality campaign implementations on deadline.
positions.insights: Skills: Developer Tools · Problem Solving · Version Control · Troubleshooting · Programming

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
• Led development of web applications, websites, games, and digital media assets across multiple client initiatives.
• Managed project planning, requirements gathering, estimation, and delivery timelines.
• Improved team processes to increase delivery consistency, profitability, and work-life balance.
• Coordinated cross-functional execution to align technical output with business goals.
